【Cadenza】
After combat initiated by unit (after
post-combat skills are triggered; before
post-action skills and Canto are triggered;
Penalty effects that last through unit's action
are neutralized), unit can attack foe again
once, within a specified distance, regardless
of unit's Range.

Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the
following conditions are met: foe can
counterattack regardless of unit's Range,
unit's Range = foe's Range, or foe's Range is
the same as the distance between unit and
foe. Skill effect's Range is determined by
unit's weapon's Range. Unit's space before
movement and unit's remaining movement
referenced by the skill remain the same as
before Cadenza. Unit cannot move, use Style,
or attack structures; unit's area-of-effect
Specials cannot be triggered, and after-combat
movement effects do not occur. If unit uses
Cadenza on foe that is within range of another
Cadenza effect, Cadenza is treated as if having
been triggered, including the other effect.
Only highest value applied; does not stack.
Does not trigger when affected by effects of
Foresight Snare or traps in Aether Raids.
Cadenza can be used only once per turn for
player team in Summoner Duels. Does not
trigger in Pawns of Loki.
